hudson.tasks.Shell.command: #!/bin/sh set -eu case "$TARGET_ENVIRONMENT" in dev|test|acceptance|production) ;; *) echo "Invalid deployment environment."; exit 1 ;; esac case "$CI_BUILD_NUMBER" in ""|*[!0-9]*) echo "Enter a valid numeric CI build number." exit 1 ;; esac rm -rf incoming deploy-context mkdir -p incoming deploy-context

#!/bin/sh set -eu case "$TARGET_ENVIRONMENT" in dev) PORT=8081 ;; test) PORT=8082 ;; acceptance) PORT=8083 ;; production) PORT=8084 ;; *) echo "Invalid environment."; exit 1 ;; esac ARTIFACT="incoming/react-app-${CI_BUILD_NUMBER}.tar.gz" CONTAINER="react-${TARGET_ENVIRONMENT}" IMAGE="react-midterm-release:${CI_BUILD_NUMBER}" test -f "$ARTIFACT" tar -xzf "$ARTIFACT" -C deploy-context test -f deploy-context/site/index.html test -f deploy-context/site/release.json test -f deploy-context/Dockerfile # Package existing files with Nginx; do not rebuild React. docker build -t "$IMAGE" deploy-context # Replace only the selected environment. if docker container inspect "$CONTAINER" >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker rm -f "$CONTAINER" fi docker run -d \ --name "$CONTAINER" \ --label "midterm.ci-build=${CI_BUILD_NUMBER}" \ --label "midterm.environment=${TARGET_ENVIRONMENT}" \ -p "${PORT}:80" \ "$IMAGE" READY=0 for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5; do if docker exec "$CONTAINER" \ wget -q -O /dev/null http://127.0.0.1/; then READY=1 break fi sleep 2 done if [ "$READY" -ne 1 ]; then echo "Deployment failed its application check." docker logs "$CONTAINER" exit 1 fi echo "Deployment successful." echo "Environment: ${TARGET_ENVIRONMENT}" echo "Source CI build: ${CI_BUILD_NUMBER}" echo "Browser URL: http://localhost:${PORT}" cat deploy-context/site/release.json
